description: Source code for a media streaming application in Android, implementing custom stream sources and media player client, including main function for playback and conversion of media files.

classes.name: MyStreamSource
classes.description: Custom stream source reading data from a file descriptor and handling buffer availability.

classes.name: MyConvertingStreamSource
classes.description: Converts media files to transport stream format and manages buffer queuing and writing.

classes.name: MyClient
classes.description: Media player client that waits for playback completion or errors.

methods.name: MyStreamSource::MyStreamSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream source with file descriptor.

methods.name: MyStreamSource::onBufferAvailable
methods.description: Reads data into buffer when available, signals end of stream if read fails.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::MyConvertingStreamSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media extraction and MPEG2TSWriter for conversion.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::writeData
methods.description: Writes data into buffers, manages buffer queue and synchronization.

methods.name: MyConvertingStreamSource::onBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles buffer availability, signals end of stream if needed.

methods.name: MyClient::notify
methods.description: Handles media error or completion messages.

methods.name: MyClient::waitForEOS
methods.description: Waits until end of stream or error occurs.
